title: Mock2 stub registry (state/stub-registry.json)
description: Every APPROVED production simulation. An entry is legitimate only when administrator-approved (state/deviations/), registered here with a severity, and visibly labeled in the running UI. Injected into every cycle's work-file context; the Run stage exposes open entries.

manifest_id.description: the integration manifest entry this stub simulates, if any

severity.description: critical = fabricated production data/security behavior (blocks succeeded on any touching cycle, UI banner, reconciliation audit); high = user-visible integration simulated (blocking on touched subsystems); medium = approved degraded fallback (surfaced on touched subsystems); low = non-production/administrative (registry + status endpoint only)

approval_ref.description: the deviation / admin-queue id that approved it
